findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
No CFM was present at time of inspection.  After talking to the PIC, they have spoken to MJ Kellner about signing up for a class through them.  Ensure at least a couple people are certified for future events so there will be at least one person present.

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Quat test strips had been recently purchased, but the facility uses chlorine.  Discussed with PIC. Ensure the proper test strips are obtained.  Test strips were left for tonight’s event.

4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
REPEAT:  Hand washing sink was not supplied with paper towels.  Discussed with PIC who filled paper towel holder on site.  Ensure paper towels are present at all times.

A plastic cup was present in the hand washing sink.  Inspector discarded and discussed with PIC.  Ensure members are only using hand washing sink for washing hands.

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

Some food splatter present on wall behind stove/fryer station in kitchen. Discussed with PIC. Ensure members clean and sanitize all surfaces after using them. Do not allow grease or food debris to accumulate on surfaces, discussed pest and contamination risk.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. 

Back door in kitchen observed to have a small gap, allowing sunlight in. Discussed with PIC. Ensure external openings remain fully sealed to protect against pest and/or weather entry. Will follow up at next routine.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; 
Handwashing sink at bar area and handwashing sink in the kitchen both lack supply of paper towels. Discussed with PIC. Ensure handwashing sinks remain supplied with soap and towels at all times. Encourage members to wash hands often while using kitchen and/or cooking for events.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED: Observed single service plates and coffee filters stored with the food contact surface exposed. Store all single service items properly. The single servive plates and coffee filters were stored properly during the routine inspection to correct the violation. 
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed a leak at the faucet of the three compartment sink. Repair plumbing at the three compartment sink.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the two soda gun nozzles behind the bar to be soiled. Wash, rinse and clean the two soda gun nozzles behind the bar.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled:
(a) fry shack - gaskets on white refrigerator (mold), 
(b) fry shack - fans near east double-doors (dust, dirt), 
(c) fry shack - light bulb sleeves (grease), 
(d) fry shack - cover over grill in southeast corner (grease).
Clean and maintain the aforementioned surfaces, and keep all fry shack surfaces as clean as possible.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Throughout kitchen, drawers holding clean and sanitized utensils are stored with sanitized surface and handles intermingled.  Store sanitized utensils with handles aligned and sanitized surface together.

750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Three baskets of single service spoons, forks, and knives were found in store room, open to the air.  CORRECTED - all three baskets were placed within plastic baggies.  Make sure all single-service items (plates, utensils, cups) are always stored in a way that protects them from contamination.

750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
The following floors and floor drains are soiled:
(a) floor drain under/behind kitchen ice machine (mold), 
(b) floor behind east top-loading beer cooler (hard-to-reach spots), 
(c) floor in hard-to-reach corners of north end of bar.
Overall, most floors appear to be very clean, however, make sure the aforementioned floors are cleaned.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
The gasket on the ice machine is loose, along the lid, and around the rim, the gasket-foam is in disrepair.  Thoroughly clean off the old, and replace ice machine gasket.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The following non-food contact surfaces are soiled:
(a) right lower interior wall of stainless steel 2-door freezer, 
(b) surfaces around mop sink.
While members appear to have thoroughly cleaned club, and have done an excellent job at detail cleaning, the aforementioned surfaces should also be cleaned.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The draft beer drain is soiled (inside) with what appears to be a slime mold and the drain hose-to-drain-pipe-junction is capped by a plastic cup which is crusted with old beer.  It is recommended that the hose and plastic cup be replaced.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
There was no soap at the kitchen hand sink at start of inspection.  CORRECTED - club member immediately replaced the soap in the dispenser.
750-1120e A supply of soap and and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: 750.830g - Chlorine test strips were not available for checking sanitizer concentration. Obtain and use chlorine test strips to verify concentration of sanitizer is at proper levels (50ppm for manual sanitizing in 3 part sinks & 100ppm for general surfaces and clean in place food contact surfaces). A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million. **Also, commercially processed ready to use quaternary ammonia based sanitizers are on-site for use. Quat test strips must also be purchased for checking those bottles**

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) trays of pizza ovens & B) soda gun holders (see #35a). Clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) inside kitchen cabinets & pans holding salt & pepper shakers; B) lower shelves of prep tables; C) shelves & bottom inside reach-in cooler; D) bottom inside 2 door freezer; E) general surfaces of pizza ovens (crumbs between the two ovens, etc.); F) plastic carts in kitchen; G) metal drawer holding oven mitts (dried food splash/debris); & H) bar - legs of sinks, soda & plumbing lines, & ledges of beer cooler door seals. Clean non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text: 750.1120 - Handsink at bar did not have soap or paper towels. Maintain a supply of soap and paper towels at all handsinks to allow for proper handwahsing.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text: 750.1160 - Two fruit flies were observed in the bar area (one by handsink, one at opposite side of bar). Soda gun holders at bar had fruit fly casings in two of them, and the third had small maggots in the bottom. All three holders were removed and taken to dish area in the kitchen where they were washed, rinse, and sanitized. Clean and sanitize the soda guns & holders as needed and maintain them clean to eliminate potential breeding location for fruit flies. Effective measures to minimize the presence of pests shall be utilized.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Back door on south side of kitchen had a gap in the bottom where light was visible. Repair the door so it is tight fitting and vermin proof. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects. **Check all outer doors and make necessary repairs. Also, make repairs to openings in the fry shack - see general comments for details**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) Piece of corner ceramic coving at the wall by the kitchen handsink was loose. Repair the coving/seal the area. B) Tiles at the entrance to the mop closet were damaged. Repair or replace the tiles. C) Floor under stove was soiled, and the coving under the kitchen 3 part sink next to the upright cooler had dust buildup. Clean the floor and coving in the aforementioned areas. All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning. The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, and floors shall be kept clean.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) Wall below kitchen 3 part sink had dust buildup (same area as coving mentioned in #36 part C). Clean the wall in the aforementioned area. B) Square opening was observed in the mop closet wall. Repair the wall. If access is needed in the area the provide a removable cover. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
Test kits for chlorine sanitizer were not available.  Purchase and use chlorine test kits.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Mold build up was seen in both drains at the bar.  Clean the drains. 750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
Coving was missing in the kitchen by the stove. Replace the coving. 750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
